text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm scheduled to have lunch with Mejiro Palmer today,
but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: —Well, something like that. Maybe it's best to just take it easy and give it a shot first~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I see... Wow, as expected of you, Palmer-san.
I'll go propose it to everyone in the shopping district right away!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! Man, Nature's as fired up as ever, huh!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "No, no, I'm just paying you back however I can. Well, Trainer, sorry for bothering you!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, the line of people seeking advice from Mejiro Palmer was endless—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It might be a bit tough, but if you do it right, wouldn't it make the General Affairs Committee's work a lot easier?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I hadn't thought of that.
I see, it's also a great opportunity
to streamline our workflow.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let us get to work on improving
the management manual right away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Man, you're always so quick to take action, it's amazing! I bet all the committee members are super grateful to you, Ikuno~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
âListen, can't you hear it?
A joyful voice saying, 'It's so nice that the flower bed has room to stretch out~'.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yes.
The flowers are swaying in the wind, looking so comfortable.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
Just because I broke a flowerpot,
I can't stay all wilted forever!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that expression, that's the one!
You've gotta light up all the flowers with your smile, Flower!

text_block_list.name: Cleaning Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ah, why was I even worrying over something like this?
Palmer-chan, you really are a lifesaver!
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who consults with Mejiro Palmer
walks away with a smile on their face.
Academy students, staff members... and even—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Target spotted! Mejiro Palmer!
Pardon me right after your training!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I hear you counsel everyone, staying close to their hearts while helping broaden their horizons!
Such conduct is truly admirable!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Knowing your skill and experience,
there's something I'd love to consult with you about, Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah! Thank you for inviting me!
If there's anything I can do to help, I'd be glad to!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...So yeah, there are girls feeling anxious about it.
That's why I think there's room for us to support them.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Appreciation! Your valuable insights were immensely helpful!
I will make good use of them in our future plans!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Same here! Hearing the Chairwoman's plan got me so excited!
I feel like the academy is going to become an even more wonderful place from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Man, getting to talk to so many people today
was an absolute win~!
choice_data_list: You really seem to enjoy giving advice.
You really seem to enjoy giving advice, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, did it look that way?
I just really enjoy listening to people talk~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I see someone looking forward and taking a step,
it kind of gives me strength, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"A spark suddenly ignited in their heart,
and that fire spread right over to mine—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"It makes me feel like I can't lose either,
and that I've gotta give it my all."
choice_data_list: Since we're here, wanna go for a little run?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"It makes me feel like I can't lose either,
and that I've gotta give it my all."
choice_data_list: Since we're here, wanna go for a little run?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice~.
Shall we pump up the vibes?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa...
Man, this really feels like our youth!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rummage, rummage)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is there something in those bushes?

text_block_list.name: Stray Cat
text_block_list.text: Nyaan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oops, and are you troubled by something?
Come on over, I'm all ears.
choice_data_list: No, I draw the line at cats...

text_block_list.name: Stray Cat
text_block_list.text: Nyan... nyan nyan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho. So you lost a turf war.
...But hey, why not look at it from the other way around?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It's a chance to dive into a whole new world!

text_block_list.name: Stray Cat
text_block_list.text: Nyaa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Mejiro Palmer even ended up taking life advice from a cat.
One caught a glimpse of just how broad-minded she really is..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! Yes, yes, exactly!
That's it~! That's what I wanted to say!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And so...
Trainer, please don't worry, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You've been worrying about me all day, haven't you?
Thinking it must be tough handling so many consultations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "‘You're not just cheering them up, you're sharing in their energy too!’ they said!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: How's that? With this, Trainer can rest easy, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reaching out to help with any trouble and turning attitudes positive—
it was a day where I learned much from Mejiro Palmer's outlook.
